severityDefinitions.high: Could invalidate safety/scientific or compliance claims; prevents operational acceptance.
severityDefinitions.medium: Material engineering or verification gap; explicit scope limits required.
severityDefinitions.low: Tracked maintainability or intended architecture gap.

items.problem: The scientific correctness of LLM interpretation has not been independently validated. A sample cache showed a weak inference from smoke-mixture findings to cool-flame behavior.
items.mitigation: Source/hypothesis/inference boundaries are visible; no safety score or intervention order. No operational use before an expert comparison set and claim-evidence audit are developed.

items.problem: A Class C target is not formal classification, software assurance, independent review or NASA approval.
items.mitigation: The 92 applicable marked rows remain open/partial; no approval or tailoring is claimed. Intended use/safety-criticality must be reviewed against NASA-STD-8739.8.

items.problem: Deep static analysis, code-coverage measurements, independent peer review and accreditation of development tools are not yet available.
items.mitigation: Local automated and EXE smoke tests exist; they do not substitute for the missing activities.

items.problem: No clean second-Windows-device test or digital signature. Operating-system dependencies include Windows PowerShell/DPAPI and a browser.
items.mitigation: Relocated-EXE and empty-PATH testing on the same machine; no separate installation/launcher; second-device acceptance is planned.

items.problem: The large curated dataset is not included in this demo's model context; only four metadata files are used.
items.mitigation: UI scope is explicit; no raw-table/sensor/gravity interpolation is invented. Future source expansion requires separate user scope and data tests.

items.problem: NPR cost/schedule/training/organizational delivery and acceptance records have not yet been provided.
items.mitigation: Preserve the user's product-plan preference without people/durations; do not remove those NPR evidence requirements and count them as satisfied. Complete them through a separate management process.

items.problem: A malicious process under the same Windows user can bypass the benefit of DPAPI protection; model-service and Windows-runtime changes are external dependencies.
items.mitigation: Do not share the user profile; bind the local server to loopback; redact logs; change the model only by explicit decision. Do not guarantee operating-system security.

items.problem: The Rust target is not implemented yet; the current demo uses Node SEA.
items.mitigation: State the actual language/architecture clearly in README; handle Rust migration as a separately tested release.
